Name: Better Quality Increased Seeds - Winter Lychee for PFM
Author: metalax
Description:
Uses the Producer Framework Mod to increase the number of seeds produced by the seed maker when higher quality produce are used.

One additional seed is given for each quality level.

Regular: 1 - 3
Silver: 2 - 4
Gold: 3 - 5
Iridium: 4 - 6

This mod covers all produce from the 'iKeychain's Winter Lychee Plant' mod that can be processed by the seed maker.

[size=4]Installation:[/size]
[list=1]
[*] Install [url=https://www.smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4980]iKeychain's Winter Lychee Plant[/url]
[*] Unzip the download and move the [code][PFM] Better Quality Increase Seeds Winter Lychee[/code] folder into [code]../Stardew Valley/Mods[/code].
[*] Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=4]Compatibility[/size]
[list=1]
[*] Created with Stardew Valley 1.4 on Windows. Should be fine on Linux/Mac.
[*] Due to PFM only permitting one rule for each combo of input and machine, this will not be compatible with other PFM mods that alter the 'iKeychain's Winter Lychee Plant' interactions with the seed maker. A compatibility patch will be required. Drop a post with a link to the other mod and I'll see about making a compatibility patch.
[/list]
